SELECT s.id, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.name, s.price, s.status, s.description, s.image, s.update_time FROM setmeal s LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.category_id = #{categoryId} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE setmeal SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, image = #{image}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
